title: Himalayan Trek - 2 Days
description: Traverse lush deodar forests, alpine streams, and panoramic ridge camps with Agam. Includes campfire nights, stargazing, and traditional mountain cuisine cooked fresh at camp.
highlights: 2-day guided ridge traverse through secluded Himalayan trails
High-altitude alpine camping with four-season tents & sleeping bags
Freshly cooked local campfire meals, mountain tea, and stargazing sessions

itinerary.title: Basecamp Briefing & Ascent
itinerary.desc: Meet at basecamp for gear check, acclimatization tea, and start ascent through pine trails.

itinerary.title: Ridge Camp Setup & Sunset
itinerary.desc: Pitch high ridge tents, capture panoramic sunset over peaks, followed by bonfire dinner.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Summit & Return
itinerary.desc: Early morning summit walk, warm breakfast, and scenic descent.

meetingPoint: Agam Mountaineering Outpost, Old Manali / Shimla Ridge Point
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure.

faqs.a: Moderate physical fitness is recommended. Beginners in good health can comfortably participate.

title: Local Cooking Class
description: Learn to prepare authentic Himachali delicacies using fresh farm ingredients, native mountain spices, and time-honored slow-cooking methods in an open-air orchard kitchen.
highlights: Hands-on masterclass cooking traditional Siddu, Madra, and Babru
Organic valley herb identification and authentic spice blending
Enjoy the sit-down feast together in a rustic cottage dining room

itinerary.title: Welcome & Herb Garden Walk
itinerary.desc: Enjoy wild mint chai and pick fresh herbs.

itinerary.title: Cooking Workshop
itinerary.desc: Cook step-by-step with guided instructions and brass degchis.

itinerary.title: Sit-down Feast
itinerary.desc: Enjoy the delicious dishes you cooked with freshly made chutneys.

meetingPoint: Valley Orchard Kitchen, Manali / Mashobra Road
cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours in advance.

title: Jeep Safari - 1 Day
description: Experience thrilling off-road mountain trails, hidden waterfalls, and rugged high passes in a customized 4x4 expedition vehicle driven by expert mountain motorists.
highlights: Private 4x4 rugged Jeep exploration across unpaved mountain trails
Visit untouched glacial streams, ancient apple orchards, and secluded viewpoints
Gourmet packed picnic lunch beside a pine forest meadow

itinerary.title: Hotel Pickup
itinerary.desc: Meet your driver and board the 4x4 expedition vehicle.

itinerary.title: Off-Road Wilderness Ascent
itinerary.desc: Navigate thrilling terrain to scenic ridge viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Meadow Picnic
itinerary.desc: Enjoy lunch in a peaceful alpine clearing.

itinerary.title: Scenic Return
itinerary.desc: Return to town with memorable photo stops.

cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before tour.

faqs.q: Is it suitable for children and seniors?
faqs.a: Yes, our vehicle is comfortable with seatbelts and shock-absorbing suspension.

title: City Heritage Walk
description: Unravel centuries of architecture, local folklore, colonial secrets, and mountain traditions through a captivating guided walking tour.
highlights: Stroll past iconic timber-framed buildings and historic landmarks
Hear fascinating insider stories and legends narrated by Agam
Sample fresh local street treats and artisanal mountain tea

itinerary.title: Meeting at Heritage Square
itinerary.desc: Introduction and overview of architectural styles.

itinerary.title: Bazaar & Old Alleys
itinerary.desc: Explore historic stone alleyways and craft workshops.

itinerary.title: Tea & Discussion
itinerary.desc: Conclude at a historic tea parlor with Q&A.

cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior.

faqs.a: About 2.5 kilometers at an easy, relaxed pace with regular seated stops.
